deploy-convex.description: Deploy backend functions to Convex production
deploy-convex.template: Run `npx convex deploy --env-file .env.prod.local` to deploy backend schema and functions to Convex production.

deploy-frontend.description: Package and deploy frontend to Hostinger via Hostinger MCP
deploy-frontend.template: Run `node scripts/pack-deploy.mjs` to create deploy.zip, then call the Hostinger MCP tool `hosting_deploy-js-application` for domain `mbventuresgh.com` with archivePath set to the absolute path of `deploy.zip`.

quality-gates.template: Execute the full suite of quality gates in order: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npx prettier --check .`, `npm run build`, and `npm run test:e2e`.
